lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular centroids is visible posterior to the gills, featuring a prominent vertical alignment of five spots roughly equidistant from the final gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, higher-intensity pixels intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots localized near the leading edge and the base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four distinct, deep, vertically oriented dark-shadowed lacerations are visible across the gill region, indicating significant physical trauma posterior to the ocular region.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more spaced patterning on the primary lateral flank.
